text:
Situation: Aprepitant 80 mg capsules are low at Corvale East (71 capsules, 8.4 days on hand). Corvale General holds 239 capsules (26.4 days) and Corvale Lakeside holds 27 capsules (16 days). The drug is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1292960 classified the manufacturing plant OAI with an end date of 2025-11-21 and a known date of 2026-02-26. An import alert (66-40) for the same firm was published on 2026-04-23, and a warning letter was issued on 2026-05-27.

Our position: Internal supply can cover Corvale East through a transfer from Corvale General. External purchases are available from BluePoint Laboratories, Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA, and Sandoz Inc., none of which appear on FDA's shortage list today. Their labels do not name a plant we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 47 capsules of 80 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. If additional supply is needed, transfer 3 capsules of 80 mg from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. If transfers are insufficient, purchase from BluePoint Laboratories — needs buyer.
4. If transfers are insufficient, purchase from Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA — needs buyer.
5. If transfers are insufficient, purchase from Sandoz Inc — needs buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications; those are for the treating clinicians and the committee.
